content.comment_body: Y a-t-il une possibilité de communication entre [product_name] [version_no] et une carte Modbus TCP/IP qui n'est pas de [company_name] ?

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Please note that English is the official language on the international forum. Kindly write your future posts in English so everyone can participate. If you are not comfortable with English, tools like Google Translate can assist. To answer your question: Yes, communication is possible.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked whether [product_name] [version_no] can communicate with a Modbus TCP/IP card from a third-party company. Another forum participant confirmed that such communication is feasible, indicating that [product_name] [version_no] supports interoperability with non-[company_name] Modbus TCP/IP devices.
